response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), type_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, analysis_count, analysis_count::numeric / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), compared AS (SELECT tradekind, analysis_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM type_shares) SELECT tradekind, analysis_count, share, share - average_share AS share_above_average FROM compared WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL AND share > average_share;
